jobs.completion: remove <=one third of current height per cut; suppress job on gravel/xeriscape/paved frontage
jobs.thresholdStatus: one-third rule primary-source guidance; target height chosen by species/site

jobs.name: Take lights down
jobs.trigger: chosen display ended + dry safe daylight + previously installed strings exist
jobs.completion: remove only previously installed set; no new religious/cultural inference

jobs.name: Event cleanup
jobs.trigger: verified/authored event ended and props or modeled debris remain
jobs.completion: remove owned props and eligible debris, leave actual plants/seasonal foliage intact

jobs.name: Plant seasonal beds
jobs.trigger: chosen eligible planting task; soil workable, correct plant/species planting range and frost risk reviewed; no calendar-only bloom
jobs.completion: new plant/bed state persists; flowers follow phenology

jobs.name: Set up a small event
jobs.trigger: verified/authored event, available eligible private/public space and local permission
jobs.completion: install selected generic props only, cleanup after event

jobs.name: Water eligible plants
jobs.trigger: soil moisture deficit and active growth, current local water policy explicitly permits method/day/time; unknown policy disables activity
jobs.completion: update simulated soil moisture, no overspray on path/road

continuity.rule: All 10 states for each US city edit the same paired base block. Preserve roofs, frontages, tree trunks, curb and street grade; only season/activity/time changes.
continuity.limitation: Image-generation camera/content continuity is visually constrained, not engine-proven. 45 degree aerial is an authoring target, not measured camera matrix. Base blocks are generic city-type proposals without real addresses.

validation.visualReview: Street/aerial scenes reviewed; targeted corrections made for decoration density, snow-free holiday nights and invented skyline towers. Generative camera/geometry identity remains unverified.
validation.pdf: 60 pages, 54 embedded images, selectable text and attached rules/source files; representative pages rendered and reviewed.
validation.limitations: Phone check is browser viewport/layout review, not an iPhone RealityKit performance or device thermal test. Illustrations are authored scenarios; no live weather state is claimed.
